title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Strictly Implementing Laws, Regulations and Judicial Interpretations and Properly Handling Expropriation and Demolition Cases in Accordance with the Law
keywords_en: expropriation compensation; lawful and proper handling of expropriation and demolition cases
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Strictly Implementing Laws, Regulations and Judicial Interpretations and Properly Handling Expropriation and Demolition Cases According to Law

Fa [2012] No. 148

To the High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

Since the promulgation and implementation of the Administrative Compulsory Law of the People's Republic of China (hereinafter referred to as the Administrative Compulsory Law), the Regulation on the Expropriation and Compensation of Houses on State-owned Land (hereinafter referred to as the Regulation), and the Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Handling of Cases Applying to the People's Courts for Enforcement of Expropriation Compensation Decisions for Houses on State-owned Land (hereinafter referred to as the Provisions), law-based, civilized, and harmonious expropriation and demolition have been widely affirmed by society. However, since the spring of this year, malignant incidents of illegal expropriation and demolition have occurred repeatedly in some areas and are showing an upward trend. In order to prevent and curb the continued occurrence of similar incidents and to create a favorable social environment for the successful convening of the 18th National Congress of the Communist Party of China, the relevant issues are hereby notified as follows:

1. Strengthen the study and training of relevant laws, regulations, and judicial interpretations.

The leaders and relevant adjudication and enforcement personnel of people's courts at all levels shall earnestly study and comprehend the Administrative Compulsory Law, the Regulation, and the Provisions, comprehensively understand and master the legislative background and specific provisions of the laws, regulations, and judicial interpretations, and earnestly study and comprehend the Supreme People's Court's Urgent Notice on Resolutely Preventing Malignant Incidents Caused by Compulsory Enforcement of Land Expropriation and House Demolition and the Notice on Earnestly Implementing the Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Handling of Cases Applying to the People's Courts for Enforcement of Expropriation Compensation Decisions for Houses on State-owned Land. In particular, they shall organize specialized training in basic people's courts to truly unify their ideological understanding and working ideas with the requirements of the laws, regulations, judicial interpretations, and the Supreme People's Court, and strictly implement them in the work of case acceptance, review, and enforcement, without unauthorized modifications or arbitrary interpretations.

2. Promptly conduct a comprehensive investigation of expropriation and demolition cases.

Courts at all levels shall, in the near future, conduct a comprehensive investigation of expropriation and demolition litigation cases and non-litigation enforcement cases that have already been accepted or will be accepted, to predict in advance, proactively respond to, and effectively eliminate potential risks that may affect social stability. At the same time, an inspection shall be carried out of the enforcement situation since the promulgation and implementation of the laws, regulations, and judicial interpretations. On the basis of self-inspection, higher-level people's courts shall send supervision teams to supervise and guide the investigation work. In particular, key inspections shall be conducted in areas where malignant expropriation and demolition incidents have recently occurred, as well as in areas such as urban-rural fringe zones, reconstruction of villages within cities, and demolition of illegal and non-conforming buildings. Resolute measures shall be taken to prevent the intensification of conflicts, casualties, or serious property losses, and the occurrence of large-scale mass incidents due to work errors, non-standard enforcement, or abuse of compulsory measures.

3. Earnestly study and resolve new situations and new problems in expropriation and demolition cases.

The main problems in current expropriation and demolition are concentrated in the illegal expropriation of land and houses, low compensation standards, non-standard implementation procedures, abuse of compulsory measures, and simplistic and crude working methods. People's courts at all levels shall, in light of local conditions, earnestly study specific issues of legal application, such as the scope of case acceptance, conditions for case acceptance, trial standards, and enforcement methods, and focus on resolving prominent issues that the masses strongly reflect, such as excessively low compensation standards, inadequate compensation, and abuse of administrative power. For major issues in adjudication and enforcement work, timely reports shall be made to local Party committees to seek support, communication and interaction with the government shall be strengthened, and efforts shall be made to actively explore innovative social management methods, clear channels for resolving administrative disputes, strive to achieve the organic unity of protecting the legitimate rights and interests of the people and safeguarding the public interest, and ensure and promote social harmony and stability.

4. Standardize judicial conduct and strengthen supervision over adjudication and enforcement.

In the process of handling expropriation and demolition cases, the case acceptance, review, and enforcement bodies of people's courts at all levels shall pay attention to strengthening communication and coordination, innovate working mechanisms, and jointly study and resolve major and difficult issues in case handling. For cases where administrative organs apply to the people's courts for compulsory enforcement of expropriation compensation decisions (or demolition rulings) for houses on state-owned land, they shall be strictly handled in accordance with the Provisions and the spirit of relevant notices of the Supreme People's Court, strictly control the gates of case acceptance, review, and enforcement, effectively embody the principle of "separation of adjudication and enforcement" (caizhi fenli), and shall not engage in joint enforcement or entrusted enforcement with local governments. Administrative litigation or administrative compensation lawsuits filed by the person subject to enforcement or interested parties due to the illegality of specific administrative acts during the compulsory enforcement process by administrative organs shall be accepted according to law. For cases applying for advance enforcement (xianyu zhixing), in principle, permission shall not be granted. Where compulsory enforcement is to be carried out by the people's court, compulsory measures may only be taken after approval by the next higher level people's court upon review. For cases involving a wide scope, significant social impact, and high public concern, the higher-level people's court shall strengthen supervision and guidance to prevent and stop illegal acts in the enforcement of lower-level people's courts and the occurrence of situations harmful to social stability.

5. Establish and improve the information and public opinion reporting system.

To facilitate understanding and mastering of information and circumstances of expropriation and demolition cases handled by people's courts at all levels, a system for reporting information and public opinion on expropriation and demolition cases shall be established and improved. In particular, during the period leading up to and during the 18th National Congress, each High People's Court shall collect and grasp on a monthly basis the situation of expropriation and demolition litigation cases and non-litigation enforcement cases handled within its jurisdiction. Wherever major risks or incidents affecting social stability arise in case handling, the relevant people's court must immediately truthfully report the relevant circumstances to the local Party committee and the higher-level people's court, ensuring accurate information and rapid reporting. Information communication channels between higher and lower-level courts shall be kept open, relevant important public opinion dynamics shall be grasped at any time, the facts and truth shall be promptly investigated and understood, and response measures shall be taken to address public concerns. The system for reporting major information shall be strictly implemented. Those who conceal and fail to report, distort the facts, and cause serious negative impacts shall be strictly held accountable for the responsibilities of the relevant leaders and directly responsible personnel, and shall be exposed and circulated in notices.

June 13, 2012
